title: See every colour a page uses
caption: Swatchly lists a site's colours by how much they are used. Filter by backgrounds, text or borders and click to copy.

title: Pick any pixel, copy it instantly
caption: The eyedropper grabs a colour from anywhere on screen and copies it as HEX, RGB or HSL. Recent picks are kept.

title: Check contrast, then fix it
caption: See the WCAG ratio for any text and background pair, with a one-click suggestion for the closest passing colour.

title: Export a palette in one click
caption: Copy the colours as CSS variables, JSON or a plain list, or download a .json file. Dark mode included.

title: Try a new background colour
caption: Paint the page background with the current colour to preview it, then undo with one click.
